scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run sync:android && npm run verify:android
scripts.build:web: npm run prepare:ocr && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.sync:android: npx cap sync android && node scripts/prepare-android-language.mjs
scripts.android:debug: npm run build && (cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug) && node scripts/verify-android-apk.mjs
scripts.test: npm run verify:release-config && vitest run && playwright test
